title: Normalized HTTP request log record v1
description: A storage-neutral record for one completed HTTP request.

schema_version.description: The immutable schema identity for this record shape.

time_unix_nano.description: The event time, usually when the server received the request, as Unix nanoseconds.

observed_time_unix_nano.description: The time at which the producer observed or collected the record, as Unix nanoseconds.

source.description: The input source from which the request record was parsed.

resource.description: The server or service that handled the request.

trace_context.description: Trace correlation context associated with the request.

url_scheme.description: The URL scheme when available, such as http or https.

url_authority.description: The URL authority, including a port when present, with credentials excluded.

url_path.description: The percent-encoded request URL path without the query component, or an applicable special request target such as an asterisk.

url_query.description: The percent-encoded query component without the leading question mark. An empty string preserves a trailing question mark.

route.description: The matched low-cardinality HTTP route template.

status_code.description: The final HTTP response status code.

request_body_size_bytes.description: The request body size in bytes.

response_body_size_bytes.description: The response body size in bytes.
